잠언 3:1.content: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:

잠언 3:2.content: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.

잠언 3:3.content: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:

잠언 3:4.content: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

잠언 3:5.content: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

잠언 3:6.content: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

잠언 3:7.content: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the Lord, and depart from evil.

잠언 3:8.content: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.

잠언 3:9.content: Honour the Lord with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:

잠언 3:10.content: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.

잠언 3:11.content: My son, despise not the chastening of the Lord; neither be weary of his correction:

잠언 3:12.content: For whom the Lord loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.

잠언 3:13.content: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.

잠언 3:14.content: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.

잠언 3:15.content: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.

잠언 3:16.content: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.

잠언 3:17.content: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.

잠언 3:18.content: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.

잠언 3:19.content: The Lord by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.

잠언 3:20.content: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.

잠언 3:21.content: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:

잠언 3:22.content: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.

잠언 3:23.content: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.

잠언 3:24.content: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.

잠언 3:25.content: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.

잠언 3:26.content: For the Lord shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.

잠언 3:27.content: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.

잠언 3:28.content: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.

잠언 3:29.content: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.

잠언 3:30.content: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.

잠언 3:31.content: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.

잠언 3:32.content: For the froward is abomination to the Lord: but his secret is with the righteous.

잠언 3:33.content: The curse of the Lord is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.

잠언 3:34.content: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.

잠언 3:35.content: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.
